## Safety Notes

- Network access: No network access is required by default.
- File access: Reads and may edit changed files only in the requested scope.
- Live action risk: Simplification must preserve behavior, tests, public APIs, and unrelated dirty changes.
- MCP, background services, and external binaries remain opt-in; do not auto-start them from this catalog row.
- Secrets, tokens, private keys, connection strings, cookies, OAuth grants, and account IDs must not be committed.
